description: Copy of the shared preset in TheEagleByte/gitops (renovate/default.json), inlined here on purpose.
This repo is a public fork, and Renovate will not load a preset from the private gitops repo into a public one: it stopped with 'Cannot find preset' and paused all PRs (Nov 1 2026).
Keep this in step with the shared preset by hand when that one changes.
Automerge policy (Garrett, Nov 2 2026): security, patch and minor updates automerge once every status check is green; majors and 0.x minors wait for a human.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule, the 3-day release-age wait and the hourly limit, and are created immediately.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly lockfile refresh so transitive dependencies don't age silently.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain guard: hold new npm releases for 3 days. Security fixes are exempt via vulnerabilityAlerts above.
Pin container images by digest where they run and keep the digest moving with the tag. Compose files are dev-only and left on tags.
Majors get their own label so they stand out.
Automerge patch, pin, digest and lockfile updates once CI is green. Renovate merges the PR itself so it always waits for status checks.
Automerge minor updates of stable (1.0+) packages once CI is green. 0.x minors stay manual.
Never automerge majors, including security fixes that need one.
